_about: The store documents of the job-search dashboard (Artifact 'Dashboard' type). Write them in one batch. Each file dataset's source.url is the url the asset upload of that file returned; dates are the export time. The tree: index (root, tiles) -> applications (keyed by job id) <- steps, actions (point at job ids) -> logins (actions point at login ids); excluded stands alone. Each section's data loads only when its tab is open.

datasets/index.title: Headline counts
datasets/index.description: The root of the job-search files: one row per headline count and the export time.
datasets/index.schedule: Daily, after the morning job-search run

datasets/applications.title: Applications from your folder
datasets/applications.description: One row per application folder, keyed by the tracker's job id; other files point at it by that id.
datasets/applications.schedule: Daily, after the morning job-search run

datasets/steps.title: Hiring steps
datasets/steps.description: One row per hiring step; its application is named by job id only.
datasets/steps.schedule: Daily, after the morning job-search run

datasets/actions.title: Things to do now
datasets/actions.description: One row per sign-in, answer or task waiting on the person; each points at a job id or a login id.
datasets/actions.schedule: Daily, after the morning job-search run

datasets/logins.title: Logins and connectors
datasets/logins.description: Connectors checked at each session start and job-site sign-ins, with how many applications wait on each.

datasets/excluded.title: Excluded employers
datasets/excluded.description: The person's one list of employers they don't apply to: one row each, with the category, the finding in words, its source, and whether their decision or their rules exclude it.
datasets/excluded.schedule: Daily, after the morning job-search run

datasets/calendar.title: Google Calendar events
datasets/calendar.description: Events in the reader's Google Calendar for the chosen window; the page keeps the job-search ones.

files/index.html.text: <the content of templates/dashboard/index.html, heading changed to the person's name if wanted>
